verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents Zapier-triggered no-code automations to 'sync with your CRM', and its workflows can 'create or update CRM records'. Signed webhooks and a REST API give a developer path for pushing bookings into other systems. CRM delivery appears to depend on Zapier or custom webhook/API work, and no native Salesforce or HubSpot connector is evidenced. Missing for 10: native Salesforce integration, native HubSpot integration, details of which booking fields sync to CRM records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
